observations: Large industrial generator with a grey metal enclosure.
Control panel features 12 circular terminal blocks and a central control panel.
The rear of the unit shows a large cylindrical engine housing.
The unit is outdoors on a wet concrete surface with a 'CAT' branded barrel in the background.
The interior shows significant dust, debris, and exposed wiring.
A blue electronic control box is visible inside the enclosure.
Watermark 'JUECO GENERATORS' and 'POSTED ON JIJI' are present on all images.
